# CI and verification tools

This directory contains the compatibility, packaging, and runtime checks used by the project workflows.

- [Verification guide](verification.md): setup and commands for each platform, browser checks, documentation, and packaged skills.
- [iOS stress guide](ios_stress.md): engine lifetime, platform views, lifecycle transitions, and memory measurements.
- [CI workflow](../workflows/ci.yml): automated package and platform checks.
- [Documentation workflow](../workflows/docs-pages.yml): site validation and publication.

See [Contributing](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the development workflow.
